summary:
Two weeks, and the client sent four messages: a wire-confirmation screenshot with the caption 'Wire confirmation' (10-16), 'Are the profiles currently recommended?' (10-20), and 'Hey! I see the voice note request, but what other customs are pending?' (10-28). That is the lowest client volume on record for this chat (4 in 14 days, against 8 in the previous 7 days and 37 the week before that). She asked two things, both reactive status/clarification questions; last window she asked zero. She paid the Oct 1-14 invoice within about 28 hours of receiving it and posted the proof unprompted. Fast payment plus near-silence is the exit pattern on this book, so the churn read stays HIGH, but the two questions are the first sign of pull from her since 10-08.

Two long-dead items finally closed in writing. On 10-16 Mayson announced that the DMCA report now rides inside the weekly earnings and performance report every Friday, and Melissa's 10-16 report included it; that ends a 226-day DMCA blackout in this chat. On 10-20 Mayson tagged the IG farm vendor ('Hey @StardustNexus can we give Liza an update on the accounts she gave us to post on!!') and Theta SDX gave the first written status in the 50 days since she handed over credentials: daily trial posts on @lizkovalenkoo and @Lizakovaal, plus reels on a backup account the vendor says it created for her, @lizanaughty. She asked whether the profiles are currently recommended and got a written 'yes they are. one of them was banned but we managed to restore it' the same day. That answer is thin (which account, when, and nobody has explained the @lizanaughty account or introduced the vendor), @Lizaakovalenk0 was not mentioned, and it came from an unintroduced vendor rather than Vivek or Derrek, but it is the first written answer to a question she first asked on 08-30.

What broke: the weekly Friday report promised on 10-16 did not arrive on 10-23 (the window closes early on 10-30, so that Friday is not yet judged). Stephski acknowledged the Oct 1-14 wire with 'Thanks love!' (10-17) and never confirmed receipt with a figure, a regression from the 10-15 behaviour. Customs turned into a four-chase loop: Jeremy Tarr (10-16, 'We are still waiting on a couple customs'), Spencer P (10-22 and 10-27 bumps), none naming what the customs were; when she finally asked on 10-28 what was pending besides the voice note, Jeremy answered in 3 minutes that it was 'just the voice note', corrected himself 30 seconds later to '2 customs ... 1 for jose and 1 for Cammy', and asked whether they show on her end. That question was unanswered at window close; so is whether the sheet is visible to her at all. The 10-11 voice-note custom is 18 days undelivered on her side, and she only engaged with it after the fourth chase. Mica posted a second consecutive bare 8-link reel-inspo drop (10-28), tagged to '@yelikovaa'; the vendor used the same handle on 10-20 while Jeremy and Mayson still tag '@xanaduexpress'. Her 09-24 question 'What exactly you need , reels/ picks?' is 36 days unanswered, there is still no written confirmation that the 09-24 customs reached the fan (35 days), and she never reacted to the 10-15 link-in-bio switch.

Jeremy Tarr was the most active ALTR sender (6 of 16 ALTR staff messages) in his first full window as AM. What he actually did: one customs chase with a sheet link, and a fast but initially wrong answer to her one question. He closed none of the old loops (tag-a-creator 277 days, monthly call 145 days since the last real one, 09-24 customs confirmation, reels/picks). Billing was 1 of 16 ALTR staff messages, the lowest share on record.

SECURITY: no credentials or codes were posted in-window. The plaintext IG passwords (client 08-31, Michelle 09-12) and the live 2FA code (client 10-08) are still in the chat, 60 days after the first, never disclosed, deleted or rotated, and the room grew again on 10-21 (the test account joined; six 'test message (disregard)' posts, excluded from counts). Derrek has been silent 87 days; the $5,000 under-credit is 51 days unacknowledged.

health.rationale: Up 2 from 43, and fragile. What moved it up: two structural complaints got written closure. DMCA reporting resumed inside the weekly report after 226 days (Mayson 10-16, Melissa 10-16), and the client received the first written status on her IG accounts in 50 days (vendor, 10-20, prompted by Mayson), including a same-day written answer to her 'Are the profiles currently recommended?'. She paid the Oct 1-14 invoice in ~28 hours and posted proof unprompted. Client asks went 0 -> 2, and Jeremy answered her 10-28 question in 3 minutes. Billing fell to 1 of 16 ALTR staff messages. What held it down: client volume is the lowest on record (4 messages in 14 days; 0.29/day vs 1.14/day last window), and both asks were reactive. The weekly Friday report promised 10-16 was missed on 10-23. Stephski did not confirm receipt of the Oct 1-14 wire with a figure. ALTR needed four chases over 12 days to get a reply on customs and never said what the customs were; Jeremy's first answer was wrong. Mica posted a second consecutive bare-link drop. The 36-day 'reels/ picks?' question, the 35-day 09-24 customs confirmation, the 60-day credential exposure, the 51-day $5,000 acknowledgement and the 87-day owner silence are all unchanged, and another member was added to a room that still holds her passwords. Churn signature: (1) PRESENT, Derrek silent 87 days. (2) ABSENT, her results question got a written answer, not a call offer. (3) PRESENT, Phone Farm updates (90 days), paid-ads stats (341 days), 09-24 customs confirmation (35 days); the IG status is now partly written. (4) ABSENT, billing 6% of ALTR messages. Tells: fast payment PRESENT; zero asks eased to 2 reactive asks; no reaction from her to the IG status, DMCA change, link-in-bio switch or either inspo drop. No export, login, data or other-agency mentions.

reminders.topic: Status on her IG accounts. She asked three times on 08-30/08-31 and again on 10-20 ('Are the profiles currently recommended?'). The 10-20 ask got a written answer within the day from Theta SDX ('yes they are. one of them was banned but we managed to restore it'), after Mayson prompted the vendor. It is the first written status in 50 days. Not answered: which account was banned and when, what @lizanaughty is and who authorised it, and the status of @Lizaakovalenk0. Vivek, the named owner, has not posted since 10-12.
reminders.note: Partially answered 10-20 (vendor, written). Remaining gaps belong to Vivek / Derrek.
